def median(xs):
    if not xs:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    return s[mid] if n % 2 else (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
spec: median(xs) returns the median of a non-empty list of numbers (mean of the two middle values for even length). The input list must not be modified. Raise ValueError for an empty list.
